title: Best Space and Sci-Fi Books
description: The best space and science fiction books: Dune, Foundation, Project Hail Mary and The Martian, plus astronomy guides for curious readers.
intro:
Some of the best voyages happen on the page. This list pairs the science fiction classics every fan should read with modern page-turners and approachable nonfiction about the universe we actually live in.

Pick a novel for the imagination and an atlas for the night sky.

picks.title: Dune by Frank Herbert
picks.commentary: The desert-planet epic that shaped modern science fiction. Start here if you've only seen the films.

picks.title: Foundation by Isaac Asimov
picks.commentary: Asimov's galaxy-spanning saga about predicting the fall of an empire, essential for fans of big-idea sci-fi.

picks.title: The Gods Themselves by Isaac Asimov
picks.commentary: A Hugo- and Nebula-winning tale of parallel universes and an energy source too good to be true, for readers who love hard science with heart.

picks.title: Masterpieces: The Best Science Fiction of the 20th Century
picks.commentary: A wide-ranging short-story anthology, a perfect sampler for new readers exploring the genre.

picks.title: Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir
picks.commentary: A lone astronaut, a dying sun and an unforgettable friendship. A funny, science-packed read for almost anyone.

picks.title: The Martian by Andy Weir
picks.commentary: Survival on Mars told with wit and real science, ideal for readers who like problem-solving heroes.

picks.title: Astrophysics for People in a Hurry
picks.commentary: Neil deGrasse Tyson's short, friendly tour of the cosmos for busy, curious minds.

picks.title: Universe, Third Edition (DK)
picks.commentary: A lavishly illustrated visual guide to the cosmos that looks right on any coffee table.

picks.title: The Astronomy Book (DK Big Ideas)
picks.commentary: The key ideas in astronomy explained simply, with diagrams, for students and lifelong learners.

picks.title: National Geographic Backyard Guide to the Night Sky
picks.commentary: A practical stargazing companion for anyone who wants to identify what they're looking at tonight.

picks.title: Space Shuttle Stories
picks.commentary: Firsthand astronaut accounts from all 135 shuttle missions, a treasure for spaceflight history buffs.
